**Pre-release (beta) — test it on your own servers; not yet production-certified.**

## Unth Recover v0.5.0-beta — readable dated copy folders, Drive folder picker, Drive from the cloud

Everything from v0.4.0-beta (backups proven by a real isolated restore; offsite copies that are
encrypted, signed and downloaded again to prove them) plus:

### Changed
- **Dated copy folders.** Offsite copies are stored as
  `<prefix>/<job>/2026-11/2026-11-11 17.30/` (`-2` for a second backup in the same minute), in
  `offsite.time_zone` (e.g. `Europe/Istanbul`; default: the server's time zone). What a folder
  holds is decided by its signed `copy.json`, never by its name. Copies made by earlier versions
  stay readable, checkable and fetchable. On Google Drive, folders emptied by retention are removed.

### New
- **Choose an existing Google Drive folder** (Settings → Connections → Choose folder…) with
  Google's own folder picker, also on shared drives. Only that folder is shared with unth; if it
  disappears later, copies fail loudly instead of going elsewhere.
- **Google Drive from Unth Recover Cloud**: a Drive connected in app.unthrecover.com (Settings →
  Storage) can be the offsite copy of a managed job. The cloud keeps the connection and gives the
  agent short-lived access tokens; copies are encrypted with the server's own key before upload.
  Update the agent on your servers to use it.

### Tested
Unit and integration tests for the dated layout (time zones and month changes, same-minute
suffix, retries, new-machine list/fetch, copies moved to another job rejected, pre-0.5 copies),
the picker flow and shared-drive retention against a fake of Google OAuth + Drive, the agent's
Drive broker, and S3 (SeaweedFS) end to end with the new folder names; cloud e2e: the real agent
copies a verified backup to (fake) Drive through the cloud. Details: docs/TEST_RESULTS.md.

### Known limitations
- Not yet tested by the project against a real Google Drive account (the Google OAuth client and
  picker key are not yet configured)
- Linux only; the local data directory is not encrypted (offsite copies are)
- Restoring into your production database is manual (`pg_restore`); roles/privileges are not verified
- Docker socket access is root-equivalent

### Install
```bash
curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unmadethings/unthrecover/main/scripts/install.sh
sudo sh install.sh --version v0.5.0-beta
```
Or: `sudo apt install ./unthrecover_0.5.0-beta_amd64.deb` · `sudo dnf install ./unthrecover_0.5.0-beta_amd64.rpm` ·
download `compose.yaml` and `docker compose up -d` · `docker pull ghcr.io/unmadethings/unthrecover:v0.5.0-beta`

Unth Recover Cloud: create an account at app.unthrecover.com, click **Add server** and run the
one-time command. Offsite setup: docs/OFFSITE.md · Agent: docs/AGENT.md
